business_problem: Swedbank is a multinational bank with a 200-year history. Recently, the company took the bold decision to migrate its big data platform to the cloud in search of greater scalability and security. With Azure Databricks functioning at the core of this solution, the successful migration has brought the bank a wealth of benefits.
solution_summary: Swedbank built this solution on Azure Data Factory, Azure Databricks. Swedbank is a multinational bank with a 200-year history. Recently, the company took the bold decision to migrate its big data platform to the cloud in search of greater scalability and security. Azure Data Factory moves and orchestrates data from source systems into the analytics platform. Azure Databricks processes, transforms, and engineers large data sets for analytics and machine learning. The flexibility and scalability of the Microsoft Intelligence Data Platform, with its enhanced security, became a north star for us to steer a new course,” explains Ragavendra Singh Jaswal, Team Manager for Cloud Enginee One that would allow us to benefit from the AI and machine learning capabilities enabled by Azure Databricks, using automation to further enhance, accelerate and streamline our security measures.

solution_components.name: Azure Data Factory
solution_components.role: Moves and orchestrates data from source systems into the analytics platform.

solution_components.name: Azure Databricks
solution_components.role: Processes, transforms, and engineers large data sets for analytics and machine learning.

data_flow: Operational data is ingested through Azure Data Factory from line-of-business systems, engineered and transformed in Azure Databricks so business teams can act on a shared set of insights.
